item.title: Supporting "The WebXR of Things" at MeaningfulXR 2026
item.description: IoTone Japan submitted “The WebXR of Things” as a poster to MeaningfulXR 2026 (MXR26) — IoTone, Inc. is sponsoring the open-source reference design, released as part of Project MAG*Net.
